select count(*) as "count" from (select * from "public"."customer_jobs" where "account_id" = ? and ("billing_entity_id" is null or "billing_entity_id" = ?) and "customer_id" = ?) as "j" inner join "customer_job_types" as "t" on "t"."job_type_id" = "j"."job_type_id" and "t"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customer_job_categories" as "cat" on "cat"."customer_job_category_id" = "t"."customer_job_category_id" and "cat"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customers" as "c" on "c"."customer_id" = "j"."customer_id" and "c"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join (select "customer_job_id", sum(CASE WHEN is_transaction_billable AND retainer_id IS NULL AND customer_invoice_id IS NULL THEN total_transaction ELSE 0 END) as "total_transaction" from "billing_scope"."customer_transactions" where "account_id" = ? and "customer_id" = ? group by "customer_job_id") as "cycle" on "cycle"."customer_job_id" = "j"."customer_job_id" limit ?
